name: Cindrella Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Cindrella Financial Services Ltd is in the business of providing loans and other finance services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CFSL is in the business as a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company. It derives its revenues from interest earned on long-term loans, rental income and fees for consultancy services.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.7% over last 3 years.
